cd /workspace/scratch && cat > diag.py <<'EOF'
import sys, random, time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/scratch'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
import gen_big, analyze as A
import z3
seed=int(sys.argv[1]); ns=int(sys.argv[2])
rng = random.Random(seed)
req = gen_big.build(rng, tight=False, nsnap=ns)
inst = A._parse_request(req)
m = A.Model(inst)
t0=time.time(); k = m.find_k(); print('k=%s %.2f' % (k, time.time()-t0), flush=True)
m.enter_F(k)
pos=[]; always=[]
t0=time.time()
for d in inst['domains']:
    b = m.bmap.get(d)
    if b is None: continue
    r,_ = m.check((b,))
    if r==z3.sat:
        pos.append(d)
        r,_ = m.check((z3.Not(b),))
        if r!=z3.sat: always.append(d)
print('possible=%d always=%d (%.2fs)' % (len(pos), len(always), time.time()-t0), flush=True)
print('always', always, flush=True)
# now count remaining free domains
free = [d for d in inst['domains'] if d in m.bmap and d not in always and d in pos]
print('free domains: %d' % len(free), flush=True)
EOF
(timeout 100 python3 -u diag.py 3 3 > diag.log 2>&1; echo exit=$? >> diag.log) & sleep 70; cat /workspace/scratch/diag.log
